title: The Mysteries of a Parent's Love

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much running I can do once I
get off the train and get
home. Either way,
I have to run twice as much as usual
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sweep?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet, come with me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What? Why?! I told you I was going
home—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just shut up and come! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What? Geez, what does she want now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stay there! I'm going to cast one of my
greatest spells on you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A spell? Wait a sec—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Brassavola ☆ nodosa! ☆ Paphiopedilum ☆
delenatii!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Uh... Nothing's happening.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-I just messed up a little, that's all!
As a favor, I'll cast it on you
one more
time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Brassavola ☆ nodosa! ☆ Paphiopedilum ☆
delenatii!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Brassavola ☆ nodosa! ☆ Paphiopedilum ☆
delenatii!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Why, why, why isn't it working?! Why aren't any red roses appearing?! And why won't any white pigeons come out?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Red roses? White pigeons?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This spell is really amazing! No matter how
sad you are, it turns your
frown upside
down the moment you see it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma showed it to me so many times... Hic! It really is super amazing! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Were you trying to comfort me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No! I was trying to cast a spell on you
because you looked sad!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Magic, huh? Hehe...Thank you. I really
appreciate you doing that for
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure your grandmother loves you very
much.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sniff... What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She used sleight—er, real magic to cheer
you up, right? Her love for
you allowed
her to do that.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Really. You can only cheer someone up
when you give them enough
attention to
notice that they're upset to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's like with my mom. She used to take me
to the amusement park or
out shopping
when I was feeling down. I'm sure it's
because she...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...was always looking after me.

"I hope you like the swimsuit I got you.
You've been so busy lately.
Take some
time to visit the beach or pool once in a
while, dear. Love,
Mama."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Was that why... she sent me the letter?
Not because I did poorly at
the
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...but because she cared about me... and
saw that I needed a break?
Is that... Is that
really it?

Daiwa Scarlet freezes for a moment and
clutches her head.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course that was it. There's no way that
Mama would've been that
mean...
Normally, I would've realized her intent
right away, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are you mumbling about? Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. I'm just realizing how out of sorts
I've been...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? What'd you say? I couldn't hear you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If that's my problem, then...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Maybe what I need right now... is to have
some fun.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Right. Let's go, Sweep. Thank you for
casting that spell on me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what is going on?! Wait... Do
you mean my magic worked?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Well done, Sweep Pea! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? So you're not going home?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Nope. Sorry for being so indecisive.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No worries! I have nooo idea what
happened to change your mind,
but—oh,
where's Tickezo?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, Scarlet! You came back! Nice timing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Since this is Maruzen's hundredth visit
here, they said we can have
exclusive use
of the entire light-up pool tonight as a
special treat!

text_block_list.name: Spe and Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We can?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! I'd completely forgotten about
that!
